_about: Independent published residential bills used to check the calculator. Pre-tax = the source's total minus its gross-receipts-tax/regulatory-fee line. FMEA totals exclude franchise fees in the column used.

sources.PSC_OCT_2026: Florida PSC, 'Florida Investor-Owned Electric Utilities Total Cost for 1,000 Kilowatt Hours - Residential Service', October 1, 2026. https://www.floridapsc.com/pscfiles/website-files/PDF/Utilities/Electricgas/BillingAdjustments/ba_total-2026.pdf
sources.FMEA_MAY_2026: Florida Municipal Electric Association, Electric Bill Comparison, May 2026. https://assets.noviams.com/novi-file-uploads/fmea/Rates/2026/2026_May_Rates.pdf
sources.FMEA_SEP_2026: Florida Municipal Electric Association, Electric Bill Comparison, September 2026. https://assets.noviams.com/novi-file-uploads/fmea/Rates/2026/2026_September_Rates.pdf

checks.note: FPL rates in May equal October rates per both sources' 1,000 kWh totals
confirms the flat per-kWh transition rider

checks.known_difference: PSC table uses fuel of $41.27/1,000 kWh (Duke's Jan-May 2026 factor); Duke's Sheet 6.105 effective Sept 1, 2026 shows 3.465 cents ($34.65). All non-fuel components match.
checks.note: 157.09 - 4.06; PSC annualizes Duke's seasonal base (3 winter months)
